scope: California outer-coast browse sectors (catalog/coastal-sectors.json), north to south. Bays and offshore islands need their own packages and are not inventoried here.

labels.MEASURED: copied or summed from pixel/cell counts already recorded in a repo catalog
labels.ESTIMATED: derived with a stated assumption, usually assigning a raster or reach to a sector by latitude
labels.UNKNOWN: no catalog figure exists in the repo; not filled by guessing

tiers.5 m: > 2 m and <= 5 m (includes VR BAG 1-4 m refinements recorded only as <= 4 m)
tiers.none: no native grid with recorded cells

limits: Grid spacing is not sounding accuracy; no source here is qualified as an MLLW fishing depth.
Coverage percentages exist only where dist/data/seafloor-ledger.json supplies a 0-300 ft reference area (provisional BlueTopo 0-100 m band, about 0-328 ft).
NOAA counts come from bounded audits (files <= 100 MB); larger or failed files are open items, not zeros.
Overlapping surveys are not deduplicated in any km2 sum below.
This inventory changes no map layer, target, score or export.
